data: {{Top}} {{Image}} {{Droid |type=Galactic Republic |image=[[File:RG-G1_CE.png]] |name=RG-G1 |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[19 BBY]],The events of "[[Victory and Death]]" take place during the beginning of the [[Great Jedi Purge]], which is dated to [[19 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. aboard the ''[[Tribunal]]''{{TCW|Victory and Death}} |creator= |manufacturer=[[Industrial Automaton]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' |line=[[R-series]] |model=[[R4 astromech droid]] |class=[[Astromech droid]] |cost= |length= |width= |height=1.06 [[meter]]s {{C|3 [[Foot|ft]], 6 in}} |mass= |gender=[[Gender|Feminine programming]] |pronouns=She/her |sensor=[[Color|Black]]{{TCW|Shattered}} |plating=Black and gold |armament= |equipment=[[Scomp link]]{{TCW|Shattered}} [[Ascension cable]]'{{TCW|Victory and Death}} |affiliation=[[Galactic Republic]] }} '''RG-G1''', nicknamed '''G-G''', was an [[astromech droid]] with [[Gender|feminine programming]] that served the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. When [[Order 66]] was executed, G-G [[Skirmish aboard the Tribunal|assisted]] the former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], alongside astromech [[droid]]s [[CH-33P]] and [[R7-A7]], in locating information on [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] [[Fives|CT-5555]] "Fives" and later capturing [[Clone Commander]] [[Rex|CT-7567]] "Rex" to remove his [[Behavioral modification biochip|control chip]]. G-G, alongside Cheep, was subsequently destroyed by mind-controlled clones while assisting Tano and Rex's escape from the doomed [[Star Destroyer]]. ==Biography== ===Assisting Ahsoka=== RG-G1 was stationed aboard the ''[[Tribunal]]'' that was sent to [[Mandalore]] in the final [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Clone Wars]]. Following [[Maul]]'s capture during the end of the [[Siege of Mandalore]], the [[332nd Company]] and former [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] escorted him back to the ''Tribunal''. Shortly after, the ship jumped into [[hyperspace]] to return to [[Coruscant]]. [[File:TeamAhsokaDroids-Shattered.png|thumb|left|300px|RG-G1 (left) was eager to assist Ahsoka aboard the ''Tribunal''.]] Following the [[Great Jedi Purge|execution]] of [[Order 66]], G-G, along with fellow [[astromech droid]]s [[R7-A7]] and [[CH-33P]], agreed to assist Tano after she came looking for help upon evading execution by [[Clone Commander]] [[Rex|CT-7567]] and his men. The astromech aided Tano in her apprehension of Rex by helping the other two droids stop him and trap him between [[blast door]]s. R7 shocked Rex unconscious after Tano revealed herself to him, and the droids carried him to the [[medical bay]], where he could be operated on and have his [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chip]] removed. While the procedure was ongoing, since the other clones were attempting to break into the room, Tano ordered G-G to be ready to re-seal the door. The clones did eventually manage to get the door open, but she was eventually able to close it again before assisting Cheep in welding the door shut. ===Hangar and destruction=== Ahsoka, Rex, and the droids fought their way out of the medical bay in order to reach the [[hangar]] of the Star Destroyer. Once reaching the command center of the hangar, Ahsoka ordered G-G to find out what had happened to the ''Venator'' by accessing the [[computer]]. G-G subsequently informed them that the [[hyperdrive]] had been destroyed: unbeknownst to Tano and Rex, this had been done by Maul, who Tano had earlier released from the detention block as a distraction. The droid also revealed that the doomed [[Star Destroyer]], which had subsequently fallen out of [[hyperspace]], was now caught in the [[Gravity|gravitational pull]] of a nearby [[Unidentified moon|moon]]. Meanwhile, R7-A7 opened the doors to [[Bay 12]] and revealed a large number of clones, led by [[Clone Lieutenant]] [[Jesse|CT-5597]] "Jesse", waiting for them in the hangar. As Ahsoka and Rex distracted the clones by faking Ahsoka's capture, the droids snuck through the hangar behind them. The droids lowered the lifts in the hangar in order to assist Ahsoka and Rex in their fight against the clones before Maul entered the hangar, attempting to steal the shuttle. Maul knocked Ahsoka off balance and she nearly fell into the opening created by the lowered platforms, however G-G caught her with a suction cup and attempted to pull her up. As Ahsoka was occupied, Maul entered the shuttle and managed to almost fly out of the hangar before Ahsoka pulled him back with [[the Force]]. She managed to hold onto the shuttle for several moments before letting him go in order to defend Rex. In this time frame, R7-A7 was destroyed by a blaster shot. Following Maul's escape and R7-A7's destruction, Cheep and G-G continued to raise and lower the lifts in the hangar to allow Ahsoka and Rex to reach a ship in the lower deck. However, after raising the platforms, the clones located the two droids. G-G and Cheep attempted to surrender, but the clones [[Death|executed]] them. ==Characteristics== RG-G1 "G-G" was 1.06 [[meter]] (3 [[Foot|feet]], 6 inches) tall [[R-series]] [[astromech droid]], with feminine programming. She had black and gold plating and was equipped with a [[scomp link]]. G-G was very loyal and was willing to help Ahsoka Tano escape despite the danger. G-G also showed a great deal of bravery, willingly going into a dangerous situation to assist Tano. ==Skills and abilities== RG-G1 was proficient at starfighter maintenance and piloting. She was also good at information retrieval and repairs. ==Behind the scenes== RG-G1 first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|seventh season]] episode "[[Shattered]]." G-G's full name was first given in the accompanying Bucket List video.{{SWYouTube|RaNeHJyTA8s|Star Wars: The Clone Wars | "Shattered" Clip | Disney+|sw_url=video/shattered}} Her paintjob and name may be based on the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania_Railroad_class_GG1 Pennsylvania Railroad GG1 Electric Locomotive].{{Twitter|missingwords|status/1282391468531838976|[[Matt Martin]]|quote=I don't actually know but Dave loves trains so I think there's a pretty good chance you're right.|archivefile=File:AccordingToMattDaveLovesTrains.png}} ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Shattered}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Victory and Death}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|RaNeHJyTA8s|Star Wars: The Clone Wars | "Shattered" Clip | Disney+|sw_url=video/shattered}} {{1stID|RG-G1}} *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/shattered-episode-guide|text="Shattered" Episode Guide - The Clone Wars}} *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/victory-and-death-episode-guide|text="Victory and Death" Episode Guide - The Clone Wars}} *{{InsiderCite|200|Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Final Countdown|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'': The Final Countdown|reprint=1}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|BB-8 and Other Astromech Droids}} *{{SW|url=news/hasbro-star-wars-reveals-january-2024|text=Hasbro Fanstream: Ahsoka's Grand Admiral Thrawn Joins the Black Series and More!}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|r7-a7|R7-A7}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=RG-G1 |es=RG-G1 |ka=RG-G1 |nl=RG-G1 |pl=RG-G1 }} [[Category:Droids of the Galactic Republic]] [[Category:Droids with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Droids with feminine programming]] [[Category:R4 astromech droids]]
